metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the almanac mark, a line late in Navarre, and the sheet for Susanna and Anne.

yesterday: Susanna is twelve. The mark in the almanac is "Susanna, xij".
You came in a line late as Navarre. Wednesday is the same play.
The letter is written. It goes on the fifth of June. The thimble went on the fifteenth, at 2s 6d.
The question about the gardeners is asked. The struck line is a blot.
The king is two-thirds made. That is what you told Anne.
